ctcoInteractiveProtocol: P1 sends public commitments, Root_fold, CtxBind_fold, and challenge-independent fold trace commitments
P2 opens challenge-tape-selected trace blocks and algebraic responses; V recomputes the tape and checks Root_fold
proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: source CCS witness, fold randomness, decomposition witness, and CE-opening witness
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_fold is independent of legacy n_fold once CTCO preconditions hold
openInputs: quantum dishonest-prover special-soundness bound for the CTCO fold protocol

ctcoInteractiveProtocol: P1 sends terminal public commitments, Root_terminal, CtxBind_terminal, and terminal residual/obligation trace commitments
P2 opens selected terminal CE and local-relation blocks; V checks Root_terminal and deterministic terminal equations
proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: terminal residual-opening witness, terminal obligation witness, and CE-opening witness
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_terminal is independent of legacy n_terminal once CTCO preconditions hold
openInputs: quantum dishonest-prover special-soundness bound for terminal CTCO

ctcoInteractiveProtocol: Verifier first deterministically decompresses to the unique canonical terminal transcript
P1 sends Root_compressed_terminal and CtxBind_compressed_terminal over the canonical decompressed transcript
P2 follows the terminal CTCO response shape; V rejects if compressed bytes do not decompress to the unique transcript before any binding comparison
proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: same as terminal, after canonical deterministic decompression
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_compressed_terminal is independent of legacy n_compressed_terminal once CTCO preconditions hold
openInputs: canonical decompression uniqueness proof bound to H_bind

ctcoInteractiveProtocol: P1 sends public statement binders, Root_numiseal_terminal, component-root binder, replay/provenance binders, and challenge-independent lane/aggregate trace commitments
P2 opens challenge-tape-selected residual, lane aggregation, scalarization, and component-root material; V checks Root_numiseal_terminal and deterministic verifier equations
proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: source-fold witness, terminal witness, product obligation witness, lane/aggregate witness, component-root witness, and optional carry witness
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_numiseal_terminal is independent of legacy n_numiseal_terminal once CTCO preconditions hold
openInputs: delayed-message binding for artifact, provenance, replay, and optional carry binders

ctcoInteractiveProtocol: P1 extends the NumiSeal terminal CTCO first message with randomness-session and leakage binders plus mask trace commitments
P2 opens selected masked residual, mask tensor, session, and leakage consistency material; V checks Root_numiseal_zk_product and deterministic ZK product equations
proofKindProtocols.extractorTarget: everything in numiseal-terminal plus mask witness, randomness-session witness, and leakage witness
proofKindProtocols.numericLossExpression: epsilon_qrom_extra_numiseal_zk_product is independent of legacy n_numiseal_zk_product once CTCO preconditions hold
openInputs: CTCO special-soundness plus ZK simulator composition for the masked residual relation
